answer: Reputation-weighted cold-start throttling: new identities earn throughput only after completing paid, irreversible work. Each task escrows a cedar deposit that decays to the payer, not the worker, on abandonment. An attacker cloning N agents pays N full deposits plus idle time; honest agents pay once. The nebula score aggregates verified completions, gating queue priority. Clones gain nothing from juniper-level history because reputation cannot transfer, so sybils restart at zero and outspend honest peers per unit of real output.
